capabilities: Plan TODOs in month and week calendar views with due dates
Manage tasks in lists with tick-box sub-items across multiple Org files
Repeat TODOs using standard Org repeaters and preview future occurrences
Reorder tasks, lists and sub-items by drag and drop or touch menus
Archive completed TODOs into per-file archive files
extras: Hard dependency on the separate Org Reader plugin, which replaces Orgmode (cm6); only one plugin can handle .org files. The README states the plugin makes no network requests and reads only the configured .org files.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in calendar planner or list-based task manager, and none that work on Org-format TODO files editable in Emacs.

relations.evidence: It provides the .org editor that opens when you click a TODO title.

summary: Task planner that manages TODOs in Org files with a month/week calendar, Google Tasks-style lists, sub-items, repeating tasks and drag-and-drop.
